description: pyBuildingEnergy is Eurac Research's Python library for building energy and comfort assessment. It implements thermal-zone calculations based on ISO 52016-1, including heating and cooling needs, indoor temperature and design loads, with additional domestic-hot-water and system modules. Users supply building and system descriptions plus weather from EPW files or PVGIS; outputs include calculated loads and temperatures at hourly or monthly detail, depending on the method. Coverage is globally configurable for residential and non-residential buildings, with examples for Athens and Bolzano. Public source, documentation and software releases are free under BSD-3-Clause. A limitation is that the README distinguishes implemented calculations from planned functionality, including supply-air humidity conditions. Its references to standards do not establish independent certification of every implementation. The library supports building-demand and retrofit simulations, complementary to EnergyPlus (model-energyplus). The repository provides example commands, method audit documents and a software DOI. No weather series, building inputs or code dependencies were downloaded, and no standard-compliance test was run.
